mapper.sql: select cr.record_id, cr.caller_number, cr.caller_name, cr.caller_address, cr.call_time, cr.end_time, cr.duration, cr.agent_id, cr.category_id, cr.content, cr.answer, cr.status, cr.transfer_id, cr.ticket_id, cr.call_uuid, cr.record_file, cr.recording_url, cr.record_duration, cr.asr_status, cr.transcript, cr.ai_summary, cr.ai_summary_status, cr.ai_summary_time, cr.ai_summary_fail_reason, cr.create_by, cr.create_time, cr.update_by, cr.update_time, cr.remark, a.agent_name, c.category_name from ai_call_record cr left join ai_call_agent_status a on cr.agent_id = a.agent_id left join ai_consultation_category c on cr.category_id = c.category_id
mapper.select: where cr.agent_id = #{agentId} order by cr.call_time desc

select count(*) as total_count, sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as completed_count, sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as transferred_count, sum(case when status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as missed_count, avg(duration) as avg_duration from ai_call_record

select a.agent_name, count(*) as call_count, sum(case when cr.status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as completed_count, avg(cr.duration) as avg_duration from ai_call_record cr left join ai_call_agent_status a on cr.agent_id = a.agent_id group by cr.agent_id, a.agent_name order by call_count desc

select c.category_name, count(*) as call_count from ai_call_record cr left join ai_consultation_category c on cr.category_id = c.category_id group by cr.category_id, c.category_name order by call_count desc
select date(call_time) as date, count(*) as call_count from ai_call_record where call_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date(call_time) order by date
select count(*) as todayCalls, ifnull(sum(duration), 0) as todayServiceDuration from ai_call_record where date(call_time) = curdate()

select count(*) as callCount, sum(case when date_format(call_time,'%Y%m') = date_format(now(),'%Y%m') then 1 else 0 end) as monthCallCount, max(call_time) as lastCallTime from ai_call_record where caller_number = #{callerNumber}

update.trim: record_file = #{recordFile}, recording_url = #{recordingUrl}, record_duration = #{recordDuration}, asr_status = #{asrStatus}, transcript = #{transcript}, update_time = sysdate()

mapper.update: update ai_call_record set ai_summary = #{aiSummary}, ai_summary_status = '2', ai_summary_time = sysdate(), ai_summary_fail_reason = null, update_by = 'call-summary-ai', update_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId}
update ai_call_record set ai_summary_status = '3', ai_summary_fail_reason = #{failReason}, update_time = sysdate() where record_id = #{recordId}
